name: Starveil Moon
summary: Cang Yue is unexpectedly transported into a video game and learns that the only way to return to the real world is to complete the story's assigned missions. Inside the game, she becomes the last surviving descendant of the Moonshade Clan, whose main quest is to uncover the truth behind her clan's massacre and seek justice for its destruction. To investigate, Cang Yue infiltrates the royal court of Donglin and meets Jing Yuan, a seemingly ordinary eunuch. Believing Emperor Si Xingxuan to be responsible for her clan's downfall, she initially targets him as the object of her revenge. As the story unfolds, however, she discovers that Si Xingxuan is merely a puppet controlled by the Grand Princess, Si Xinglan, and that the extermination of the Moonshade Clan was a conspiracy orchestrated by Si Xinglan herself. Joining forces with Si Xingxuan and Jing Yuan, Cang Yue uncovers the truth behind the tragedy and ultimately brings Si Xinglan to justice. After completing the game's central quest and fulfilling her mission of revenge, she successfully returns to the real world.

name: Devotion: Obedience or Betrayal
summary: Hidden from the outside world, one of the most controversial Christian communities is finally exposed. Bound by obedience to God, Gloriavale is under siege — accusations of sexual abuse and cover-ups threaten their existence and their cult denial.

previousepisode.name: Chapter Three: The Choices We Make

name: Wind Up
summary: A sports fantasy growth drama based on baseball, that tells the story of a high school baseball player and an unknown transfer student

name: Les Crues
summary: The Crues decide to make a dream come true by creating their own wine, and the challenge shows them just how important their friendship is.

name: Raja London Ka
summary: 2 men from different worlds, 1 from the bustling streets of Lunda Bazaar, other from corridors of political power bound by the weight of early responsibilities discover that true love isn't about possession, but the courage to let it go.

name: Wo Shi Ding Ji Sha Shou， Bie Re Wo
Mr. Big
summary: The MR BIG unit organises sting operations to obtain confessions from suspects of serious crimes.

name: Bittersweet Love
summary: Born into poverty in a rural village, Lu Xiaofan unexpectedly enters an elite family in the capital as the live-in son-in-law of a powerful official's household. He once believed this marriage would change his life, only to discover that he is merely a tool used to cover up a family secret. In this unfamiliar and ruthless world, the only person willing to reach out to him is his wife's older brother, Bei Luqing. One is a young man from the bottom, desperately trying to rise above his fate; the other is a cold, handsome golden boy standing at the top. But what happens when they both fall for the one person they should never love?

name: The Great Famine
summary: In September 1845, a devastating new plant disease swept across Ireland, destroying the potato crops on which the majority of the people depended. Aid from the British government was too little and too late. Over the subsequent six years, a million Irish people died of starvation and a more than a million others fled abroad in order to escape the ravages of hunger and disease.

name: Squatters: Get The F*** Out of My House
summary: A Queens homeowner is arrested trying to enter her own house. A con artist loots a missing millionaire's estate. A grieving family watches a stranger wear their dead mother's clothes and then gets sued for $400,000 by the squatter from prison. And a New Jersey homeowner has a jaw-dropping showdown involving the S.W.A.T. Team. In Squatters: Get the F*** Out of My House, the new docuseries from executive producers Kelly Ripa and Mark Consuelos, families are forced into shocking and emotional battles against squatters exploiting legal loopholes to live rent-free in homes they don't own. The six-part series follows ordinary people blindsided by manipulators who know exactly how to weaponize tenant protections and turn the legal system against the very people it's supposed to protect. From Queens to Malibu to Newark, each case is more infuriating than the last — and the system keeps failing the people who hold the deed.

previousepisode.name: The Squatter and the S.W.A.T. Team

name: The Empress'sGood Fortune
summary: On the first day of waking up and entering the palace, she reads her own fortune, which tells her that the key to success is to be a slacker. She eats, sleeps, and idles her time away, staying away from harem disputes in peace—until she accidentally helps Noble Consort Liu find her cat. However, she resolutely fends off challenges and outsmarts others to maintain her coasting status, even inadvertently promoting peace in the harem.

name: Guai Guai Nu Tui Chang，Jing Quan Lang Zi Zen Me Yan Hong Le
Jin Tian Pei Zong He Yue Liang Tan Lian Ai Le Ma
Love Island: The Debrief
summary: The final three ladies from season 12 of Love Island (UK), Shakira Khan, Toni Laites and Yasmin Pettet discuss all the Villa gossip after each episode. Absolutely nothing is off-topic or out of the question!

name: Lust
summary: In a world where power can buy lives, everything becomes a game of desire and obsession. Deep dive into lust, money, and raw desire.

name: When Light Fades
summary: Early dawn, October 6, 1976. Amidst the roaring gunfire and explosions echoing across the university campus, Rawin and his friends lost everything in the blink of an eye. Left with no choice, he stepped onto a path of no return. Rawin chose to abandon his comfortable life and disregard his mother's desperate pleas, venturing deep into the dense jungle toward a land of shared ideology with his comrades. Within the dark and perilous wilderness, fate brought him face-to-face with Comrade Yue, a calm and cold-hearted young fighter who saved Rawin's life from a deadly animal trap just in the nick of time. Surrounded by exhausting hardships and the heavy weight of their ideals, an unspoken feeling quietly began to form between them—like a faint starlight still shining through the darkest night. And perhaps... on the road to "Baan Saeng Dao." This is the beginning of a journey that is not just a battle for their ideals, but a story of a deep bond slowly forging under the starlight.

previousepisode.name: The Starlight Fades, But Love Remains

name: Night Shift for Cuties
summary: Two pop superfans go from besties to rivals when the chance to see their favorite group in Korea tests the limits between devotion and obsession.

name: Манюня
summary: In the late 1970s, in a small provincial town, girls Manyunya and Narine live a joyful and adventurous life. Their everyday life is filled with pranks, friendship, the first childhood worries, and amusing misunderstandings that invariably involve adults: the strict but kind Granny, dad Misha, and Narine's parents, Nadya and Yura. Narine's younger sister, Karinka the "meteor," and her eternal "victim," Rubik, join the gang, making the stories even more unpredictable. From trying to tame a kitten and fix a car to playing "adults" and staging their own theatrical productions, the girls learn friendship, mutual support, and responsibility. Their pranks often turn into funny and sometimes even instructive lessons, but most importantly, Manyunya and Narine always stay together, turning their childhood into a true fairy tale.

name: Morfeusz
summary: Morpheus is the story of Piotr Leyer, a lawyer who, through an unfortunate turn of events, finds himself at the head of a gang. When young Leyer takes control of the organized crime group previously led by his brother—and before that, his father—it quickly becomes clear that he fits in surprisingly well with the underworld. The seemingly ordinary husband and father fulfills his new responsibilities with increasing effectiveness, slowly pushing the boundaries of morality one after another.

name: Yani Neko
summary: Welcome to Yani's apartment. Please don't mind the smell. Yani is a catgirl with a seriously bad smoking habit. Every time she tries to quit, she becomes weak to the cravings and gives in almost instantly. Behind on her rent and unable to hold down a job, her friends and sister rally around to help her out. But when she's using her pee to put out cigarette fires, they may just have their work cut out for them.

previousepisode.name: Nyaa will still be smoking in the final episode.

name: Keep The Meter Running
summary: New York City-based comedian and YouTube creator Kareem Rahma launches a new series where the journey truly is the destination. In each episode, Rahma hops into a yellow cab and asks the driver to take him to their favorite place - with one condition: keep the meter running. What begins as a simple fare quickly evolves into a deep dive into the driver's world and a moving exploration of the American Dream, as Kareem asks the poignant questions he never had the chance to ask his own cabbie father. As the meter rises, each ride becomes a space for connection and storytelling, where Kareem learns about the lives of the people behind the wheel and ultimately discovers a little more about himself. "Keep the Meter Running" is produced by Rahmavision and AND Media. Kareem Rahma and Adam Faze serve as producers.

previousepisode.name: Off The Meter, On The Record — 40 Years As An NYC Cabbie

name: Rolf Harris: Primetime Predator
summary: A national treasure. A shocking trial. Rolf Harris: Primetime Predator exposes for the first time how celebrity, nostalgia and unchecked power shielded decades of abuse.

name: Adieu Solo
summary: It is a fake reality drama set against the backdrop of a luxury resort in Pattaya, Thailand, where eight young men and women engage in a love survival game that blurs the lines between sincerity and pretense, ideals and reality.

name: Lot Patrol
summary: Lot Patrol follows a mismatched squad of eccentric security guards as they patrol the chaotic backlot of a major Hollywood studio, wrangling unhinged actors, rogue crew members, and their own wildly dysfunctional personal lives.

name: Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha EXCEEDS Gun Blaze Vengeance
summary:
Thirty years ago, the sudden appearance of unknown invasive alien lifeforms nearly brought about the end of the world.

Since then, humanity and these creatures, known as Invasion Species, have continued to clash over living territory. Although human safety is barely being maintained, the world remains on the brink of collapse. As the threat of death and destruction lingers, people go about their daily lives by turning away from the constant danger around them. In response, the United Nations establishes EXCEEDS, an organization tasked with investigating and combating threats caused by the Invasion Species.

The story begins in the Far Eastern island nation of Mizuho, where Shiina Kuze, a young hunter who exterminates invasive species, lives on a remote island. Wanting nothing more than a quiet life with her only family—her younger sister, Setsuna—Shiina's routine is disrupted when an unexpected incident occurs, drawing her into a much larger conflict.

previousepisode.name: The Flame Connecting Me to You

name: Da Bu Liao Liang Ban Dao
Michael Jackson: The Verdict
summary: Told by key players who were inside the courtroom, this comprehensive documentary dissects the trial of Michael Jackson and his complex legacy.

name: Welcome to Catalina
summary: Los Angeles County Sheriff's Detective Stilwell has been "exiled" to a low-key post policing rustic Catalina Island. But while following up the usual drunk-and-disorderlies and petty thefts that come with his new territory, Stilwell gets a report of a body found weighed down at the bottom of the harbor.

name: Abandonados
summary: Forty years after being abandoned at a Barcelona train station, three siblings embark on a final quest to discover their identities and solve a mystery that remains unsolved.

name: Weird Kids
summary: Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe reminisce about their weird days as child actors and discuss all the eclectic things that have made and continue to make this world more fun.

previousepisode.name: Boy Meets Weird with Will Friedle

name: Muhtemel Aşk
summary: Defne, who climbed the career ladder with her own efforts in her 30s, has always built her life on her own feet, as her mother taught her. Defne, who is strong, controlled and does not give up the order she is used to, one day realizes how tired and lonely she actually is. Maybe it's time to truly fall in love for the first time in your life. However, the two men he encounters will turn everything upside down. Nothing will ever be the same for Defne, who is caught between Kadir's direct and shocking attitude and Tolga's games that change the balance. Misunderstandings, jealousies, challenges and an attraction that grows as you escape; It will draw the audience into a passionate love story.

name: Tip Toe or Ta-Da
summary:
Attitude has partnered with Channel 4 to launch a digital series tied to Russell T Davies' new drama Tip Toe, which launched on Channel 4 on 31 May.

Titled Tip Toe or Ta-Da, guests including Danny Beard, Charley Marlow, Jason Patel and Jaxon Feeley unpack the programme's themes in honest and raw conversations, filmed in the Canal Street bar that serves as the real-world setting in Tip Toe itself.

previousepisode.name: Danny Beard on masculinity, Pride flags and the hijacking of patriotism

name: Не может быть! или приключения Забавы
summary: Human civilization plunged into a digital Stone Age when the space travelers, the Architectons, stripped humanity of its technology. The world, entangled in networks and chips, suddenly became dark and silent. But even in the darkest times, there are those who refuse to give up. The young and precocious Zabava, along with her AI friend Zhuzha, embark on a desperate mission. Their goal is not only to recover lost knowledge but also to find Zabava's missing mother. The key to salvation lies in her father's invention—a time machine. The journey leads to the distant and mysterious 21st century—an era of technological advancement. Here, Zabava will make many discoveries: why food spoils and what an "expiration date" is, why cows need "mood statistics," and how farmers monitor plant health and understand where to grow a bountiful harvest.

name: Brexit: A Very British Civil War
summary: The inside story of a vote that divided a nation. Unravelling the rivalries, betrayals and conflicts that tore apart the campaigns, told by those at the heart of Leave and Remain.

name: Dealies
summary: A savant salesman. A gentle gladiator. A quiet virtuoso. A summoner of the divine. And the poor soul who hired them. All part of the staff at Dealies, a big box store. They are masters of the delicate alchemy of trade. Prophets of enterprise. And occasionally they do some actual work.

name: To Defy the Stars
summary: Young Demon Lord Wei Jie is taken in as the unlucky disciple of Cui Xiaoxiao, a disaster-prone sect leader cursed with ten misfortunes. A journey back 200 years brings two people from the wrong timeline together at the right moment. From constantly teasing and saving each other to risking their lives side by side, they eventually join forces to expose a divine conspiracy, rewrite fate, and protect the world.

name: The Embroidered Truth
summary: After embroidery house owner Wu Lian ruins countless lives of the female embroiderers in his climb to power, Lin Rulan, one of the embroiderers, survives a tragic betrayal while her loyal friend Meng Wan spends three years plotting in silence. Joined by survivors and unlikely allies, they launch a ruthless takedown of the corrupt elite and fight for justice

name: The Found Family
summary: Lin You, a freshly released juvenile offender with an unusually strong fate, stumbles into the "Daji Agency" and lands a job as a haunted-house tester. Teaming up with Xu Liuliu, a girl with special heterochromatic eyes, they unravel one mystery after another. Each "ghostly" case hides a shocking human twist beneath the surface. Through their comics, they help lingering souls find peace or break their own inner demons, walking the line between yin and yang to achieve their own redemption.

name: The Villager of Level 999
summary: In Earthclear, everyone is born into a fixed role, and villagers are the weakest of all. Most never rise above Level 5—except Koji Kagami, who is Level…999?! On a monster hunt, he meets Alice, the Demon King's daughter, and discovers they share an impossible dream: coexistence between humans and demons. In a world destined for conflict, they charge into battle to defy fate and shatter the rules.

previousepisode.name: Lv12: Damned Ideas of Common Sense

name: The Silk Master from the Future
summary: Modern doctor Li Yunhe transmigrates as a despised son-in-law. Using his modern medical knowledge, he revives the lost royal silk, outwits rivals, and dazzles the court at a grand fashion event. After crushing a rebellion, he rises from obscurity to legendary status.

name: Made In India: A Titan Story
summary: A visionary man Xerxes Desai with his team turns humiliation into history by building India's first world-class watch brand, proving that time itself can be reclaimed through courage, failure, and innovation.

name: The Murder Puzzle
summary: Deputy Captain Li Kaiyang of the major crimes unit teams up with his reluctant apprentice Jiang Han to crack a series of sexual assault cases and a bizarre naked-body murder. But then a falling-death case emerges, and the supposedly gunned-down "Red Gloves" mysteriously returns to life, unleashing more horrors. Piece by piece, a decades-old puzzle comes together, thanks to the master-and-apprentice duo's relentless sacrifice.

name: Blooms for Her
summary: Driven by a blood feud, Deathsworn Mei Lin enters a lethal game for the throne. She is the mad prince's favorite weapon, a stand-in for a cruel heir's forgotten dream, and the obsessive object of a hostage prince's fierce devotion. As desire and deception collide in the imperial court, unfolds as a brutal, poignant spectacle of love and betrayal.

name: Call For Dr. Jiang
summary: Jiang Tian Cai, a gifted but aloof maxillofacial surgeon, suffers a major setback in his life and starts anew at a dental hospital in a small coastal town. In the confines of his clinic, he shows unwavering dedication to his profession and learns empathy while protecting patients' oral health.

name: Portland Street Operation
summary: Twenty years behind bars for a crime he didn't commit. Liang Zhiqiang, once the deadliest enforcer of the Heyi Syndicate, returns to find his sworn buddy Xie Guanhong now rules the underworld and has married his ex-lover Zheng Baojiao. Liang tries to go straight, finding solace in a flower shop and a new love with a teacher, Danni. But the old world drags him back through shadows of past crimes, shifting loyalties, and a truth that shatters everything. He learns that the underworld never forgets. This time, he bets it all, not for brotherhood, but for the people he truly cares about.

name: The One
summary: Top lawyer Su Yan, now thirty, lives by one rule: love yourself first, at least eighty percent. Abused by her mentor, neglected by her family, and cheated on by her fiancé, she has sworn off letting anyone close. Then Cheng Lin reappears. At nineteen, he is no longer the boy she once helped at a juvenile detention center. For five years, he has never stopped loving her. His return forces her to face the wounds she has buried. Together, they heal each other, piece by piece, and slowly remember what it means to trust, to risk, and to love again.

name: Camellias
summary: Jiang Yukui, the Holy Maiden of the Zhao Tribe, survives a childhood of captivity and embarks on a quest for revenge after learning of her sister's death. Armed with divine powers and drawn into the orbit of the formidable Feng Ye, she finds an unexpected ally and love while battling a tyrant emperor and his ruthless empress. But when Yukui discovers her sister is alive and the true mastermind behind a years-long scheme to seize power, a deadly game of twin deception begins. As love and vengeance collide, destiny leads them toward the day the camellias finally bloom.

name: I Am Fei Fan
summary: Framed and jailed for four years, Ren Feifan, heir of the renowned Kui Medical Hall, returns to North City to uncover the conspiracy that destroyed his family, expose the culprit behind Wang's Pharmaceutical, and revive his heritage against foreign threats to traditional Chinese medicine. Reunited with his ex-fiancée Xu Ruojin, the two slowly reconnect. Standing together through crisis and chaos, they rebuild trust, support each other, and face the future side by side.

name: Endless Love
summary:
This is the blood-soaked tale across three lifetimes of Mu Ruyi, Princess of Xiling, and Ling Xiao, Prince of Dongqing. She saved his life, but he returned with vengeance. Their wedding was stained in blood, love and hate intertwined. She faked her death and returned as a shadow, seeking retribution. He drowned in his own obsession, unable to rise, bound by the heart-blood and the oblivion herb. In the end, their love and hate were bound together by fate. Three lifetimes of glances. Is it fate? Or Misfortune? In the end, it was just three acts they played alongside each other in this life!

Adapted from "Endless Love", the song of the same name by Hailai Amu.

name: Queen Silvia
summary: What began as a chance encounter between German-Brazilian interpreter Silvia Sommerlath and Sweden's young Crown Prince Carl Gustaf at the 1972 Olympic Games in Munich turned into one of Europe's most iconic royal love stories.

name: La otra mitad del sol
summary: Two people have loved each other in past lives, and that love is represented in a sun-shaped medallion that splits in half, and if the couple does not reunite it will have a tragic end.

name: En cuerpo ajeno
summary: Upon dying suddenly, Pedro José Donoso discovers that he was betrayed and murdered and is reincarnated as a young and attractive peasant named Salvador Cerinza to take revenge.

name: Tiempos difíciles
summary: Six university students are assigned to do their internships in El Difícil, a small Colombian town in the middle of the conflict between the army, the guerrillas and the paramilitaries.

name: Intekhab
summary: Some choices bring happiness, while others change lives forever. Get ready for an emotional journey filled with love, dreams, and unexpected twists.

name: Ticket to the tribes
summary: In this new reality show, 12 well-known Dutch and Flemish celebrities live together with the Himba community in Namibia. This means the participants must live without modern amenities and adapt to the tribe's way of life. The participants are judged on their effort and their respect for the culture. The celebrities who are least able to adapt are eliminated. Ultimately, only one participant remains. This person is named an honorary member by the community.

name: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage
summary: The great sage Ephtal dies in despair after failing to reach the peak of magic—but 400 years later, he's reborn with all his memories and power intact! In a world where magic has decayed and ancient spells are treated as miracles, Ephtal storms into a prestigious magic academy to reclaim the true art of sorcery. As his power shakes the world, long-forgotten legends begin to awaken!

name: Toda la verdad de mis mentiras
summary: Two roommates find their friendship tested by unspoken feelings during a road trip in this "light, refreshing and entertaining" rom-com hailed by Woman.

name: Kitchen Chaos
summary: Kitchen Chaos will dive headfirst into the wild, unpredictable world of food with viral moments of jaw-dropping culinary triumphs and spectacular meltdowns, from hibachi tricks gone wildly off the rails to bizarre and unhinged food recipes that must be seen to be believed. Along the way, professional chefs deliver hilarious reactions, insider tips, and practical takeaways that reveal what went wrong, what went right, and how to avoid culinary chaos at home. It's a fast, flavor-packed ride through the creativity, chaos, and comedy of food culture.

previousepisode.name: Flaming Fiascoes and Hotshot Hot Dogs

name: Pitmasters
summary: Pitmasters is a raw, relentless, real-world BBQ competition unlike anything ever attempted on Food Network. A non-stop week-long battle set deep in the wilderness where teams of the most notable pitmasters will push the boundaries of what BBQ can be as they compete over live fire to prove they are the best of the best. They will be cooking from sunrise to sunset to sunrise again, fighting for survival and their share of up to $50,000 in prize money. Teams must manage fire, fatigue, and challenges within challenges to impress an elite panel of judges.

name: Kitchen Undercover
summary: Kitchen Undercover, a high-stakes, sneak-attack restaurant rescue, led by chef Antonia Lofaso, alongside sous-chef Nestor Milian who will go full undercover, slipping into failing restaurants that are one more bad review away from total collapse. While Antonia watches the drama unfold from a secret command center— spying on every meltdown, mistake, and questionable choice—Nestor will be on the inside, embedded with the staff, stirring the pot and digging up the juicy truth. From toxic team dynamics to tragic food, nothing will stay hidden for long. When the real reasons customers aren't coming back are exposed, Antonia will storm in to shake things up, call out the chaos and whip these teams into shape. But with the clock ticking and closure looming, only time will tell if Antonia can turn these hot messes into hot spots.

name: Gui Bu Yu Zhi Po Xiao
The Pyramid Scheme
summary: The Pyramid Scheme follows the story of Goldy, an ambitious but impatient young man, whose quest to get rich through a pyramid marketing business spirals into a rollercoaster of chaos - risking not just his future, but also the love and trust of his close-knit joint family.

name: The Marriage Plot
summary: The Marriage Plot follows three recent college graduates caught in an all-consuming love triangle as they reconcile their youthful romantic aspirations with looming adulthood and make life-altering choices about love and identity.

name: The Break-In
summary: In the aftermath of a devastating home invasion, Alice Rathbone refuses to accept that the tragic event was simply random. Desperate for answers, Alice starts pulling at threads and soon finds a trail of dark secrets that spiral closer to home than she could ever have imagined.

name: Ordinary Love
summary: Fumihara Ichiro and Higashi Kei are colleagues whose relationship began through a shared love of movies. While Kei admires Ichiro as both a mentor and a supervisor, neither expects their growing bond to develop into something more. Haunted by past trauma, Ichiro has long avoided deep connections, believing he could never share his life with someone else. Kei, meanwhile, has never experienced romantic attraction and considers himself someone untouched by love. After Ichiro confesses that he is gay, the two eventually begin a relationship. One year later, however, Ichiro is still plagued by doubts. Twelve years older than Kei and unable to understand why someone like him would choose to be with him, he questions whether Kei's feelings are truly romantic. As they confront their insecurities and learn what love means to them, the two must discover whether the life they are building together can become the ordinary love they have both been searching for.

name: A Winter Sun Wakes the Wind in Spring Hills' Dream
summary: At the peak of his career, top celebrity Feng Qinglang escapes to a remote tea mountain, seeking a brief respite from the spotlight. Instead, he meets Xu Changyang, a free-spirited young tea farmer with an untamed soul. One belongs to the dazzling world of fame, the other to the forests and the land. As they grow closer among the mountains and wilderness, love quietly takes root. But the relentless scrutiny of the entertainment industry and the harsh realities of society soon close in, pushing them toward separation time and again. In the end, will they follow the call of their hearts and risk everything for love?

name: Fix the Error!
summary: Ji Han, the grim reaper who manages death, receives a list of names and descends to the human world again today. School, unfamiliar scenery, and a strange self. But the task seemed simple: he simply needed to find the target of the code floating above his head. But the code written on the register hovered over two people simultaneously. One was Hyeon Jun, with his indifferent gaze, the other Yung Hui, with his playful smile. The question, "Who should die?" soon morphed into "Who should live?" and Ji Han, hiding his identity, began living as a student alongside the two.

name: Fear Factor Célébrités
summary: Patrick Huard invites three artist friends, each accompanied by someone close to them, to push their limits and face their greatest fears in Celebrity Fear Factor. In each episode, the pairs try to avoid elimination by overcoming three challenges that are as spectacular as they are terrifying. At the end, the winning duo donates $5,000 to the charity of their choice.

name: Los Topuria
summary: Ilia Topuria is one of the biggest stars in MMA. A documentary that explores his personal side and reveals a side of the champion never seen before.

name: Lost to Light
summary: Maybe famous… or maybe not yet. Disband the group?! No way!!! Once an idol group with dreams of stardom, they're now forced to wear mascots and sing children's songs for kindergarten kids. Humiliating? Absolutely. "But boss… even that song was successful." "3,500 views?! That's your definition of success?" Everyone quits. Everyone—except Jeng (Dome Phemadech), the only one who stays beside Boss Sithian (Aomstin Thakrit).

name: Labyrinth of Hortensia and the Minotaur
summary: A human mystery centered around a set of 200-year-old human remains discovered in the Himalayas, whose DNA perfectly matches that of a missing sister-in-law.

name: Houkago wa mystery to tomo ni
The Alien Autopsy Scandal
summary:
In 1995, 18 minutes of grainy film shocked the world and sparked one of the most compelling mysteries of our time. The so-called ‘Alien Autopsy' footage appeared to show three government officials in hazmat suits dissecting the corpse of an alien recovered from a crash-site near Roswell, New Mexico in 1947.

The footage became an international sensation, captivating film experts, military analysts, and even the Secret Service. But the question remained: was it genuine, or an elaborate hoax? The truth is far from straight forward.

From director John Dower, this stranger-than-fiction documentary series follows members of an ambitious group of filmmakers who found themselves at the centre of an unprecedented media storm after re-creating a landmark alien encounter in a North London apartment, with some still insisting it was based on a genuine film recorded by the US military.

As debates over extraterrestrial life reach the highest levels of the U.S. government, with military whistleblowers testifying to encounters with unidentified aerial phenomena, the series ventures deep into the wider world of ufology and the impact of Alien Autopsy.

From Roswell's enduring origin myth to the mysterious Calvine sighting in Scotland, it explores the stories, sightings, and scraps of evidence that continue to divide believers and sceptics alike.

name: Rental Love Lab
summary:
Rental Love Lab: A Trial of Love
"Love Lab" is a jack-of-all-trades shop ready to handle any job for its clients.
"Claire," a feisty female employee, is tasked with taking care of "Eris," a famous mystery novelist.
Eris needs someone to recreate "love scenes" for her new novel.
From a crazy scene reenactment, the distance between the two gradually widens.
When one person has never understood "love,"
and the other has never believed in it, this experiment… might unexpectedly become a real feeling.

name: Tera Banna Chala Hoon
summary: A story about a shattered dream, an unlikely meeting, and the beginning of something neither of them saw coming.

name: Blackout
summary: Can a "Blackout" save a boring romance? Set in the romantic streets of Lijiang, Yunnan, the story follows a couple who have lost their spark. They traveled to this ancient city hoping to relive the magic of their first "romantic encounter," but the feelings just wouldn't come back. However, everything changes after a night of heavy drinking and a total blackout. They meet a mysterious new boy—a real "adventure" they never expected! What happens when "Fresh Blood" enters the mix?

name: Zombie House Flipping: Family Business
summary: In Columbus, Ohio, power flipper Tommy Harr and his family have built a business on seeing opportunity where others see disaster. Their edge comes from within the family — two generations of elite home inspectors, a fearless construction crew led by his middle brother, and a mom who doubles as both designer and real estate agent. Together, they take on the city's worst "zombie" houses, transforming rundown properties into stunning dream homes.

name: Designed To Last
summary: Sponsored content made in collaboration with American Family Insurance. Three teams of home design innovators face off against the worst Mother Nature has to offer to see whose build is truly designed to last. Part competition, part science experiment, each episode tests a different element—until one team reigns supreme and wins the $100,000 prize.

name: Weather Command Weekend
summary: Stay up to date inside the Weather Command center with a weekend forecast and real-time alerts.

name: The Vanishing of Debbie Griggs
summary: Chronicles the investigation into the 1999 disappearance of 34-year-old Debbie Griggs, a pregnant mother of three who vanished from her home in Deal, Kent - a case spanning more than two decades with incredible twists and turns.

name: Hong Le Ying Tao Lu Le Ba Jiao
Love in Sync
summary: An emotional transference romance that unfolds as a woman who denies empathy and a man who bears the burden of empathy come to share each other's emotions. Cha Eun Hwan, a man who bears others' emotions excessively. He is a psychological counseling expert who has gained widespread popularity for his unique counseling methods. However, after becoming entangled in an unexpected incident, his everyday life and emotional balance begin to unravel. As he falls into despair, a figure connected to his past appears, bringing changes to both his life and his emotions. Yoo Ji An, a former girl group member who was once called the "Nation's Idol" and enjoyed explosive popularity, is now working as an actress. Having lived her life suppressing her emotions under her mother's strict control since childhood, Ji An faces a crisis due to controversy over her acting skills, stemming from her lack of empathy. She then meets Cha Eun Hwan, a psychological counseling expert, and unexpectedly experiences "emotional transference." Through this experience, she begins to rediscover her lost emotions and grow as a person.

name: 33 días
summary: The escape of two dangerous criminals from the Lleida Penitentiary Center in 2001 triggered a 33-day police manhunt, marked by violence, sacrifices and loyalty.

name: Ni Shi Wo De Ren Jian Shen Qi
Jia Fang Dian Xia Qing Zi Zhong
Ni Hao, Wo De Su Liao Jie Mei Hua
Love as Bait
summary: After a sudden accident, Lu Zaozao finds herself transported into the Republican era as Su Muwan, the young mistress of a wealthy family. She awakens to a husband pointing a gun at her, her parents framed for a crime, and a series of poisonings. Fighting her way through one crisis after another, she goes from mortal enemies to falling deeply in love with the "jealous" Ling Shenxing. But just as their romance blossoms, she suddenly wakes up in the modern world—only to encounter a familiar face around the corner.

name: Ta Ruan Zai Wo Xin Shang
UFC Rivals
summary: UFC Rivals is an electrifying deep dive into the most iconic feuds in UFC history. Blending gripping archival footage, exclusive interviews, and a dynamic roundtable, the series revisits the unforgettable moments and high-stakes drama behind the fiercest battles inside the Octagon. UFC superfan, Mario Lopez brings together fan-favorite voices, including C.M. Punk and Ken Shamrock, to break down the rivalries that defined eras, shaped legacies, and helped propel the UFC into a global phenomenon.

name: Graf Yoster gibt sich die Ehre
Fly to Fin
summary: When all four young men of the band Jingle Bell entered university, they want to reunited the band after they parted ways. But still lacks the lead singer That's why the 5th member joined in; June, a dark-faced young man, very handsome and a voice crushing women. It was like a bolt of lightning struck their hearts one after another, and the Jingle Bells were born again. As well as being well known in their university.

name: Suea Chani Keng
summary: Three BFFs live in the same condominium building and face life and love together. Tum, a playboy photographer who doesn't believe in true love because his girlfriend left him with a luxury condominium to pay off alone. Oil, Tum's friend, offers to help him find a roommate to share the rent. Turns out the new roommate is Cheetah aka Chatree, Tum's gay friend who used to be secretly in love with him. Tum cut off his friendship with Cheetah a long time ago because Cheetah tricked him to believe that he was straight.

name: Во что верят люди
summary: The boldest hypotheses about our world, along with phenomena and places shrouded in mystery. The mysterious Library of Atlantis, the Yeti, Antarctica as humanity's last refuge, and oceans hidden beneath the Earth's crust—mainstream science dismisses these wonders, yet many people believe in them. We are giving them the chance to tell their stories in detail.

name: Big Girls Wanted: Escaping Pearadise
summary: Pearadise promised safety and a utopia for plus‑size women. The sisterhood turns dark as allegations of assault and coercion spread among the women.

name: Il peccato e la vergogna
summary: In the Rome of the '30s lives Nito Valdi, a difficult boy just out of the reformatory, who works for a boss in the area with his friend Tony.

name: Baciamo le Mani Palermo - New York 1958
Zabt
summary: Ayla, a beautiful young girl, is deeply in love with her cousin Ehtisham. But their love is caught in a long-standing family conflict, where their mothers' hatred keeps them apart at every step. Unseen and unheard, Aoun—a quiet young man living only with his grandmother—carries feelings for Ayla, though she has never noticed him. Sometimes, fate brings two hearts close only to pull them apart again. Their love is tested by family conflicts and hidden betrayals, breaking what once felt strong and real. In the middle of this pain, a broken heart finds comfort in the one who has always loved silently. But this connection is not fully accepted by the heart, as emotions remain confused and uncertain. Will Aoun ever express his love to Ayla? Can Ayla and Ehtisham stay together despite their family conflict? Will Ayla ever realize who truly cares for her?

name: Tapish
summary: Shahzer is a young heir to immense wealth, known for his strong, dominating personality and short temper. Despite his privileged background, his anger and behavior often create distance between him and others. Shifa is a strong, responsible young woman who quietly carries the burden of her family while holding onto her dreams through patience and sacrifice. Maaz, Shifa's cousin and fiancé, shares a close bond with her, and they are already engaged in a relationship built on family trust and mutual understanding. Fate takes an unexpected turn when Shahzer crosses paths with Shifa and feels an unexplainable pull toward her—completely unaware that she is already engaged to Maaz, his closest friend. This hidden truth soon becomes the center of emotional conflict, testing friendship, love, and loyalty. Will Shahzer ever get Shifa, or is she already beyond his reach? Will Maaz discover Shahzer's feelings for Shifa? Will love win for Maaz and Shifa, even with Shahzer around?

name: Hercule
summary: Hercule follows Hercule Poirot's first cases in London before he becomes the world's most famous sleuth. The series is an intimate study of Hercule the man and an epic portrait of Britain between the wars. The series takes a magnifying glass to three of Christie's most celebrated stories, while also charting Hercule's burgeoning friendship with Captain Arthur Hastings, his early encounters with Scotland Yard's James Japp, and introducing him to one particular nemesis...

name: Half as Interesting's Crime Spree
summary: Half as Interesting put the 34 weirdest laws in America on a map and gave Sam 72 hours and $5,000 to break eight of them. But the HAI writers got $3,000 and a live tracker on Sam—and if they tag him, he loses a point. None of the rules require anyone to go to sleep at any point. What could possibly go wrong?

name: YoKoSo Scooby-Doo!
summary: While visiting Japan on the ultimate foodie adventure, Scooby-Doo and Shaggy unwittingly unleash hundreds of mythical monsters that are causing trouble across the country. With the help of Scooby's uncle, Daisuke-Doo, along with new friends, a magical girl Yume, and gadget whiz Takumi, the group embarks on an all-new mystery filled with monster chasing and fun chaos.

name: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
summary: Join Ranger Hamza on an epic African adventure! Visiting animal sanctuaries and exploring the wild, he discovers incredible animals, each with their very own story to tell.

name: Tendres Agneaux
summary: A hungry wolf desperately tries the craziest tricks to get to his favourite prey, the sheep. But the predator, despite all the schemes he employs, never succeeds and never satisfies his hunger.

name: Alatava
summary: Friends who grew up in an orphanage and, after entering adult life, engage in petty fraud and face the problems of this easy way to make money.

name: Fúria
summary: Fúria tells the story of a young man rescued from the brink of death by an MMA coach. With no memory of his own identity, he is given the name Marcelo and finds a new purpose in the world of MMA. But as he is drawn deeper into this universe, he begins to uncover clues to his past and becomes entangled in a web of crime, secrets and rivalries that reaches far beyond the cage.

name: A Hill to Die On
summary: Some things are just too important to let go.

name: Half as Interesting
summary: Half as Interesting is an entertaining, fact-based, educational series covering diverse topics of general interest presented in a somewhat humorous, quirky style. Topics range from curious to weird and are rarely important to know unless you're looking for some lunch room or coffee break conversation starters.

previousepisode.name: This Is The Shortest Train in the United States

name: Aik Mohabbat Aur
summary: Khushbakht is a determined police officer who has already experienced the painful side of love. After a failed love marriage, she returns to her parents' home with her young son and the scars of a broken relationship. Instead of support, she faces constant judgment, slowly losing faith in love. Haroon, an honest journalist who values truth and meaningful connections, struggles to find someone who truly understands him. When an investigation brings them together, he is captivated by Khushbakht's courage, dignity, and quiet strength. For Haroon, it is the beginning of love. For Khushbakht, love is a chapter she believes is over. As their lives become intertwined, Haroon sets out to prove that even the most wounded hearts deserve a second chance at happiness.

name: Andy's East Coast Kitchen Crawl
summary: Andy Hay explores East Coast food culture, one kitchen at a time.

name: Marg e Wafa
summary: Is love the name of a journey, or is it the destination? A story born from the pages of the bestselling novel Marg e Wafa is about to come alive.

name: Glee Vietnam
summary: A Vietnamese remake of the hit US show 'Glee'.

name: A Forgotten Kill
summary: A Forgotten Kill is centered on ex–Army Ranger Dani Vega, a Nuyorican from the Lower East Side and dauntless FBI agent whose specialty is breaking codes and detecting patterns. As part of a task force, Dani is partnered with NYPD Detective Mark Flint. Their clashing styles give them an edge in solving crimes and expose an undeniable chemistry, but Dani is haunted by a secret: a family tragedy in her past that comes back to put her career and life at risk.

name: Swamp Patrol
summary:
SWAMP PATROL pulls viewers into the unpredictable world of law enforcement operating in America's most unforgiving swamps. 

From the tangled bayous of Louisiana to the coastal inlets of Florida, Swamp Patrol follows officers in real time through bodycam footage as they respond to a wide range of threats, including armed suspects, drug busts, missing persons, stolen boats, 11-foot gators, and deadly snakes. 

Every call comes with its own dangers, and in the depths of the swamp, there is no backup. The series offers a captivating look at the chaos and courage required to hold the line in places most people never step.

name: Ghost
summary: When a famous actress is murdered, hacker Hades becomes the prime suspect. Captain Phakorn discovers Hades is his old friend, Phirawat. But shocking evidence points to Phakorn himself. As the real killer hunts them down, Phakorn is killed and Phirawat is left severely burned. Lieutenant Viulada helps Phirawat assume Phakorn's identity through surgery. Together, they must unravel the mystery and catch the real villain before it's too late.

name: Mercan Köşk
summary: After her husband disappears, Cemre finds herself in the mysterious Coral Mansion, where secrets from the past, family feuds, and forbidden love change her destiny.

name: Celebrity Escape
summary: Seven comedians attempt high-concept escape rooms under the watch of a mischievous Game Master. Solve the room, then survive elimination - with Panic Buttons, Gifts, Wrath, and only one winner.

name: Outlast: The Jungle
summary: On a remote tropical island, 16 players must survive the elements, outmaneuver rivals and remain part of a team for a chance to win a $1 million prize.

name: To the Stars
summary: Inspired by the remarkable achievements of China's Lunar Exploration Program, this story follows Wu Wei, a young man who has dreamed of working in aerospace since childhood. Determined to join the Flight Control Center, he is devastated when he fails the interview and is instead assigned to work in the archives. Meanwhile, Ying Ziqi, a brilliant and aloof top student with whom Wu Wei shares a long-standing rivalry, successfully secures a position in the Flight Control Center. While working in the archives, Wu Wei gains valuable experience and matures into a dependable professional. Recognizing his potential, mentor Qin Bojun personally selects him to join the Flight Control Department's elite "Mu Xing" team, where he reunites with Ying Ziqi as a teammate. Initially clashing at every turn, the two young talents gradually overcome their differences through a series of high-stakes missions, including the International Space Orbit Competition and the Haoyue-4 and Haoyue-5 lunar projects. As they learn to trust and support one another, Wu Wei and Ying Ziqi transform from rivals into inseparable partners. In a dramatic final challenge, they defy the odds, lead their team to success, and help China accomplish the historic mission of bringing lunar soil samples back to Earth.

name: El mapa de los anhelos
summary: El mapa de los anhelos tells the moving story of Greta, who claims she was born with the purpose of saving her sister Lucy, who suffers from leukemia, through her stem cells. However, events take an unexpected turn and Lucy passes away, leaving Greta with a deep existential void. Before departing, Lucy creates "El mapa de los anhelos", a game that challenges Greta to face her grief and discover her own path. On this journey, Greta will meet Will, an enigmatic young man with a haunting past. Can we love someone without loving ourselves?

previousepisode.name: Vuelve a la casilla de salida

name: Doctor Who
summary: This exciting new animated series is inspired by the beloved Doctor Who universe. It marks the first time the ‘Whoniverse' has been expanded into an animated series for pre-school audiences.

name: Xing Xing Ran Shao De Sheng Xia
Worst Yard on the Block
summary: In Worst Yard on the Block, two teams of curb appeal aficionados will search out the most unsightly yards in the country, meet the overwhelmed homeowners and perform miraculous outdoor makeovers in just a matter of days.

name: Would You Rather: Decide to Survive
summary: Would You Rather be invisible or be able to fly? Fight one giant duck or 1000 tiny ducks? Eat a man-sized bean or a bean-sized man? This comedy game show will see two teams of some of Britain's funniest digital personalities compete in hilarious real-life challenges based on classic hypothetical Would You Rather decisions. These three simple words decide everything from what they eat to who they send home...

name: Darna
summary: The origin of Darna relates that she is a warrior magically manifesting herself through a human girl from Earth, named Narda. After Narda swallows a magic white stone, she transforms into the mighty warrior by shouting "DARNA!"

name: El Cor de la Ciutat
summary: El cor de la ciutat follows the lives of the people who live and work in the neighbourhood of Sants and Sant Andreu in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain.

name: Deep End: The Scott Miller Story
summary: A compelling new two-part documentary charting the dramatic rise and fall of Olympic swimmer Scott Miller, and his ongoing fight to rebuild his life. Once a golden boy of Australian sport, Scott Miller had it all: medals, fame, and a nation's admiration. Then came personal tragedy and a fall into addiction, crime and eventually prison.

name: The Season
summary: A striving American is thrown headfirst into the world of superyachts, sun, and scandal over the Hong Kong boating season in this soapy delicious revenge thriller about the wealthy and the secrets they keep. Our story follows Coleen "Cola" Li, a summer associate for a prestigious financial firm, as her mentor introduces her to "The Season": six glorious weeks in the summer where the rich and fabulous host a series of extravagant events. During the opening party aboard a superyacht, Cola meets the important players in Hong Kong. All are beautiful. All are dangerous. All are keeping a secret. But Cola is as well. She's here to get vengeance for a past injustice, no matter the cost. Over six weeks, Cola must navigate the world of the 1%, as she infiltrates high society in their private boxes at the races, charity tables at boxing matches, murder mystery parties at amusement parks, as well as the seedier side of the rich. At the end, Cola faces a choice: do I destroy these people or become them?

name: Above Myriads
summary: After transmigrating to the Xianjiang Continent, Yi Feng discovers that he was born without a spiritual root, making cultivation impossible. With no choice but to rely on the "essential life skills" granted by a mysterious system, he struggles to make a living in this world of cultivators. What Yi Feng doesn't realize, however, is that in the eyes of powerful cultivators, his abilities are nothing short of godlike. Every casual action he takes unknowingly influences the fate of the entire continent. As he effortlessly resolves one crisis after another without realizing his true impact, Yi Feng creates countless thrilling and hilarious moments, bringing new opportunities, hope, and choices to the people of the Xianjiang Continent.

name: The Prosecutor's Office's Proposal
summary: From the director of ‘Secret Relationships', follows the romance between an investigator burdened by the stigma of "being a murderer's son" and a prosecutor.

name: Your Sky Hare Nochi Koi
summary: After a misunderstanding, a kind-hearted college student ends up in a fake relationship with a popular senior feared by everyone.

name: Power: Legacy
summary: Power: Legacy sees the return of Tommy to New York, where he partners with Tariq to take the city by storm.

name: Mock the Week: Summer Specials
summary: Dara Ó Briain is back with a summer run of topical chat and hilarious games, featuring a host of top stand-up comedians.

name: Worst Neighbor Ever
summary: You think you know your neighbors? Think again. This new series features firsthand accounts of violence, intimidation, and harassment that are more shocking than ever. Through compelling testimonials, startling body cam footage, and animated reenactments, Worst Neighbor Ever proves the people next door aren't just a nuisance - they're lethal.

name: Doppelt kocht besser
summary: Star chef Alexander Kumptner decides which of three couples cooks the best. However, the contestants are essentially amateurs in the kitchen and receive tips via headset.

name: Deep In
summary: Fresh off winning Best Actor, Chen Xin finds himself cast alongside ambitious newcomer Zhang Zhun in a daring LGBTQ+ film. On screen, they portray psychiatrist Fang Chi and his patient Gao Zhun, whose relationship spirals beyond therapy into a dangerous mix of desire, obsession, and love. Off camera, Chen Xin and Zhang Zhun begin to lose sight of where acting ends and real feelings begin.

name: Thunder 3
summary: Unremarkably ordinary middle schoolers, Pyontaro, Hiroshi and Tsubame, wander into an extraordinary adventure when Pyontaro's little sister goes missing.

name: Chéri(e), c'est moi le chef
summary: Every day, three couples compete to prepare a recipe. Only one partner knows the recipe and must guide their significant other remotely to execute it—a setup that reveals both tensions and the bond between them.

name: Chéri(e) c'est moi le chef
summary: Three couples compete to prepare a recipe. Only one partner knows the recipe and must guide their other half remotely—via an earpiece—to execute it. The guiding partners then taste the dishes blind and rate them on a scale of 1 to 10. The chef also tastes and rates the dishes. The highest-scoring couple wins a prize and secures a spot in the next episode to defend their title...

name: Knighted
summary: Knighted follows a missing person's case that spirals into an absurd documentary-style exploration of the sinister secrets lurking beneath the enchanting pageantry of a local medieval dinner theatre.

name: Free Nelson Mandela
summary: The story of Nelson Mandela's journey from activist to revolutionary prisoner, and the global movement and musical activism that helped bring his freedom.

name: Space Bug
summary: Insects are taken up into space for use in experiments by humans. The development plans and experiments are aborted by humans for no known reason, the organisms are left behind in the space station with limited resources. Going over hurdles and fighting through challenges, Mick and his friends travel across planets and gain new comrades, heading for Earth.

name: Qian Nu You Hun: Qian Chen
Jim Henson's Monster Dance
summary: Calling all Monsters! Do YOU love to DANCE? Come join the fuzzy, friendly, funky fun with Toots, Teeny and Razzle Dazzle, as they get down.

name: Egoli: Place of Gold
summary: Egoli: Place of Gold is a bilingual South African soap opera that follows the daily lives, romances, and corporate rivalries of a handful of intertwined families. Centered around a prominent Johannesburg family and the employees of their international automobile firm, the show explores the intense trials, triumphs, and tribulations of its characters.

name: Jian Dao Mei Nu Jian Xian Hou Wo Ni Xi Le
Число зверя
summary: The 1990s. Alexey Kirsanov, an investigator at the Smolensk Regional Prosecutor's Office, receives a "black mark" from the leader of a local organized crime group without a statute of limitations, and a hunt begins for him. Kirsanov's close friend and colleague, Igor Sazonov, is being promoted and transferred to the position of prosecutor of the Yaroslavl region. He offers Kirsanov to move to a new place with him, away from gang violence.

name: Santa Maria
summary: The series follows two families from very different sides of the tracks whose lives are slowly entangled by the actions of saintly but strung-out cleaner Maria.

name: Vandaag Inside Oranje
summary: Vandaag Inside Oranje is a special edition of Vandaag Inside dedicated entirely to the World Cup. The regular panelists discuss the matches, notable events, and the dutch national team's performance. The show also covers other topics that are making headlines at the time.

name: The Author I Admired was not Human
summary: A mysterious vampire novelist uses his supernatural powers to solve complex crimes alongside a rookie editor, slowly regaining his lost humanity through their bond.

name: Kalabsh
summary: Follows the journey of Selim Al-Ansary, a hardworking police officer, who was wrongly accused of murder.

name: Late Night Law
summary: Ride along as officers face the dangers and decisions that define the night shift.

name: Muhafiz
summary: What he sees as duty, she sees as control, and what begins as protection slowly turns into a silent war between a responsible man and an unwilling heart

name: Hit Man
summary: Hit Man, a series inspired by the 2024 AGC Studios feature that was co-written, produced and headlined by Glen Powell.

name: Yokya Shudan ni iru Serizawa wa, Ore no Mae da to Yosu ga Okashii
summary: Suzuki is a self-proclaimed loner secretly writing stories about the popular boy, Serizawa. But when their worlds collide, Serizawa finds himself unexpectedly drawn to Suzuki, turning fiction into reality.

name: Идеальное ограбление
summary:
In a luxury house, everything is arranged for a comfortable life: spacious rooms, a warm pool, a well-groomed territory... And most importantly, there is money in the house! The bank is replenished every day thanks to the joint efforts of the participants.

There is only one way to break this impressive jackpot — to successfully leave the house. Whichever player does it first, the entire budget will be transferred to that account. 
All entrances and exits, windows and any possible loopholes in the house are securely closed, which means that the participants will not just have to look for a way to freedom, but build a subtle strategy. Interestingly, the smart home itself is also a full-fledged hero of the project. He can ironically communicate with the characters at breakfast and challenge them during the trials.

name: Леший
summary:
Ten years ago, the life of operative Sergei Granin changed dramatically when he was seriously injured while rescuing his friend and partner Yuri Dymov. During the time the law enforcement officer was in the hospital, his wife Maria went to Dymov and took their eight-year-old daughter with her. Disappointed in his family and people in general, Granin leaves for a remote village, where he becomes an inspector of forest protection and receives the nickname Leshiy for his unsociability.

In his new position, Granin does not sit idle and helps the local district police officer Karpen in solving cases. This attracts the attention of the new chief of police, who turns out to be Dymov, who was transferred here from St. Petersburg. Now the former partners have to cross paths with each other while investigating crimes, the traces of which often lead to the forest surrounding the village of Ostrov from all sides. Granin's ex-wife and daughter, who arrived with Dymov, prevent him from focusing on finding criminals. It is difficult for the hero to find a common language with the child, and the end of the relationship with his wife has not been reached.…

name: Rosa Elettrica
summary: In Rosa Elettrica, Rosa Valera is a young agent recently transferred to the Witness Protection Unit. On her first assignment, she's assigned to Cocìss, an unpredictable Camorra baby-boss who recently repented. Having been targeted by the rival clan, the young man has agreed to cooperate with the police to save his own skin. Rosa wonders why she was chosen, but she doesn't have time to let her uncertainties hold her back. Determined to protect Cocìss at all costs, she doesn't stop even when she realizes there's a flaw in the system and that, not only is her career at risk, but her life as well. Alone against the odds, Rosa and Cocìss escape together, driven by a common goal: to save their own skin and uncover the truth.

name: Black Torch
summary: Jiro Azuma is no average high schooler. A descendant of ninjas and trained in the ancient warrior art of the shinobi, Jiro is also able to talk with animals. After a mysterious encounter with an injured cat named Rago, Jiro discovers the feline is actually the legendary Black Star of Doom! Joined by the Bureau of Espionage, they fight off swarms of mononoke lying in wait to exploit Rago's powers.

name: Dong Bei Ai Qing Wang Shi: Shan Hun Mei Gui
